name: Task Insights
author: Clearwater Tools
description: A private, offline summary of your tasks - how many are open and done, and which one has been waiting longest. Everything is computed on your device; it reads only your task list and never touches the network.

invocation.when_to_use: When the user asks for a summary, overview, report or insights about their tasks - how many are left, how they are doing, or how much is done.

capabilities.reason: Reads your tasks to count the open and done ones and find the oldest.
